q-112129.name: Question 1
q-112129.problem: A five gallons water bottle is leaking its content. The number of gallons of water left inside the bottle after $t$ minutes is given by the formula $W(t)=5\cdot {(\frac{1}{5})}^{t}.$ How many gallons of water will be inside the bottle after $3$ minutes?
q-112129.worked_solution:
To get the number of gallons of water inside the bottle after $3$ minutes, we evaluate the function at $t=3.$ Substituting $t=3$ into the function $W(t)$ gives

$$
\begin{aligned}W(3) & =5\cdot {(\frac{1}{5})}^{3} \\  & =5\cdot (\frac{{1}^{3}}{{5}^{3}}) \\  & =5\cdot \frac{1}{125} \\  & =\frac{5}{125} \\  & =0.04.\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, after $3$ minutes, there will be $0.04$ gallons of water inside the bottle.

q-112129.html:
Question 1
?

A five gallons water bottle is leaking its content. The number of gallons of water left inside the bottle after t minutes is given by the formula W(t)=5⋅(15)t. How many gallons of water will be inside the bottle after 3 minutes?

a
0.02 gallons
b
0.2 gallons
c
0.04 gallons
d
1 gallon
e
0.4 gallons
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

To get the number of gallons of water inside the bottle after 3 minutes, we evaluate the function at t=3. Substituting t=3 into the function W(t) gives

W(3)=5⋅(15)3=5⋅(1353)=5⋅1125=5125=0.04.

Therefore, after 3 minutes, there will be 0.04 gallons of water inside the bottle.

q-112148.name: Question 2
q-112148.problem: The number of subscribers to a video channel is given by $S(t)=5\cdot (2.4)^{t},$ where $t$ is the time in days since the channel was opened. How many subscribers will the channel have after a week? Round your answer to the nearest integer.
q-112148.worked_solution:
To get the number of subscribers to the video channel after a week ($7$ days), we evaluate the function at $t=7.$ Substituting $t=7$ into the function $S(t)$ gives

$$
\begin{aligned}S(7) & =5\cdot (2.4)^{7} \\  & ≈2\,293.\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, after a week, the video channel will have $2\,293$ subscribers.

q-218594.name: Question 3
q-218594.worked_solution:
We substitute $x=6$ and $f(x)=192$ into the expression for $f(x)$ and then solve for $A,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}192 & =A\cdot {2}^{6} \\ \frac{192}{{2}^{6}} & =A \\ \frac{192}{64} & =A \\ 3 & =A.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $A=3.$
